documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported a strong start to FY27 with 27% year-on-year revenue growth, 55% EBITDA growth, and 64% PAT growth in Q1. Management noted that construction equipment demand remains robust, while large agricultural equipment is experiencing a cyclical bottom in calendar year 2026 before an expected recovery. The company maintains a strong net cash position of approximately INR190 crores and continues to evaluate inorganic acquisition opportunities. Furthermore, management indicated that the full-year FY27 growth is expected to exceed the growth achieved in FY26. Uniparts India reported Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55%, and PAT growth of 64%.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than the year-on-year growth recorded in FY26.
guidance.quote: And keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management maintains a target cycle EBITDA margin of approximately 20% over peak-to-trough cycles.
guidance.quote: So Mr. Jain, when we talk about 20% margins, we are talking about 20% margins over a cycle which is peak to trough. We maintain that.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that warehouse sales will remain within the range of 52% to 56% over the next 12 to 18 months.
guidance.quote: So over a period of time, I think our warehousing sales will remain in the range of, let's say, about 52% to 55%, 56%. And I think that's where we foresee this to remain in the next, let's say, 12 to 18 months.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: The small agriculture segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

guidance.claim: Management expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4. And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment momentum from the second half of calendar year 2025 continued into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: On the construction equipment, the momentum that started in the second half of calendar year 2025 has continued into Q1 of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Conditions in large agricultural equipment remain subdued, with calendar year 2026 representing the cyclical bottom.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the large agricultural equipment, conditions remain subdued as has been widely acknowledged across the industry. Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: In small agricultural equipment, India continues to perform well while Western markets see measured growth.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories. New business wins in India in the small ag segment have been particularly strong. In the Western market, small ag growth remains more measured.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket business represented approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs expect a mid-teens decline in the large agricultural industry for the year.
demand_outlook.quote: We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum that started in the second half of CY2025 has continued into Q1 FY27 for the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: The momentum that started in the second half of CY2025 has continued into Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: India continues to perform well in the small agriculture segment, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agriculture conditions remain subdued, with leading OEMs indicating CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom and recovery expected through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Conditions remain subdued, as has been widely acknowledged across the industry. Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: After tariffs came down, management expects the aftermarket segment to normalise and return to growth.
demand_outlook.quote: With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalise and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: North American customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs affirmed that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough for large agricultural machinery.
demand_outlook.quote: Let me talk about the large agricultural machinery, continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure stood at INR12 crores for the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of materials for the quarter was about 33.3%, driven by product mix changes.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: The inventory gain reflected on the face of the financials for the quarter is roughly about INR1 crore.
margins_costs.quote: There has been a small inventory gain that you will see on the face of the financials, and that's roughly about INR1 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Direct exports serve as the base margin of around 20%, while locally made and locally sold has the lowest margin and warehouse sales have the highest margin.
margins_costs.quote: Our direct exports is our base margin of what we say 20%. And then the warehouse sales is our highest margin product.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% in quarter 4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management has consistently stated that a 20% EBITDA margin is sustainable over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability performance accounts for a INR3.4 crores impact due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: New business wins span segments and geographies across three product platforms: three-point linkage, precision machined parts, and fabrications.
orders_capacity.quote: These wins span segments and geographies and reflect continued customer confidence in our capabilities across our 3 product platforms, which are the three-point linkage for agricultural and PMP and fabrications.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: New business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over the last 12 months.
orders_capacity.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: A special dividend of INR101 crores was declared in October 2025 when the cash balance was approximately INR210 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Just to put this in context, when we declared the special dividend of INR101 crores in October of '25, our cash balance was approximately INR210 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of June 30.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared a special dividend of INR 101 crore in October 2025 when the cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: To put this in context: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility led to some demand skewing in the aftermarket segment as higher prices caused moderate purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility in Western markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing in the aftermarket segment as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Towards the end of quarter 3, one of the facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident in the finishing shop.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fresh escalation in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to build on the structural new business momentum in the construction and large agricultural equipment businesses.
management_commitments.quote: We are continuing to invest in growing our construction and large agricultural equipment businesses, given that the small ag is already a segment where we hold significant global market share. The new business momentum is structural, and we intend to build on it.

management_commitments.claim: Management believes the fabrication vertical will become a meaningful vertical within the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects normal operations from the Ludhiana facility to return on schedule.
management_commitments.quote: We expect normal operations to return on schedule.

management_commitments.claim: Rebuilding efforts for the Ludhiana facility are underway to be online by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
